plans.rationale: Early round (0/60 budget used). Only 3 cells occupied in a 10x10 grid (3% coverage), clustered at [3,4], [4,4], [4,5]. Best voltage 3.827 at [3,4]. Targeting 6 empty cells adjacent to occupied ones to expand coverage locally, reduce duplicate risk, and explore voltage-energy trade-offs near the best performer. Weights favor strain (0.4) for structured perturbations of good seeds, with rattle (0.3) and permute (0.3) for diversity. Substitute not yet allowed.

Round 1: 11/60 budget used, 4% coverage (4/100 cells). Occupied cluster at rows 2-4, cols 3-5. Best voltage 4.045 at [2,3]. Two duplicates wasted budget (strain at [3,3] and [3,5]). Permute succeeded at [3,4] and [4,4]; rattle unused. Targeting 6 empty cells adjacent to the cluster to expand coverage in under-explored directions: [2,4] (right of best), [4,3] (left of cluster), [5,4]/[5,5] (downward), [2,2] (up-left), [3,6] (right). Increasing rattle weight (0.4) to diversify structures and cut duplicate rate; strain reduced to 0.3; permute kept at 0.3 for cation-order exploration.

Recent: strain at [2,3] productive (4.045, 4.007) but duplicates at [3,3] and [3,5] wasted budget; permute 5/6 accepted; rattle unused. Targeting 6 empty cells adjacent to occupied: [2,4] (right of best), [4,3] (left of cluster), [5,4]/[5,5] (downward expansion), [3,6] (right of [4,5]/[4,6]), [6,5] (above outlier [7,5] to explore that region). Weights: strain 0.35 (structured perturbations of best seed), rattle 0.35 (diversify, cut duplicate rate), permute 0.3 (cation-order exploration). Substitute not yet allowed.

Round 8: 53/60 budget used (7 left), 7% coverage (7/100 cells) stuck for 6 rounds. Duplicate crisis: 31 duplicates (58% of evaluations), 9/11 recent rejected as duplicates/dominated. Only 2 accepted recently (rattle at [4,4], permute at [7,5]). Best voltage 4.045 at [2,3] from strain. Occupied cluster rows 2-4 cols 3-6 plus outliers [6,5],[7,5]. Many adjacent cells targeted since round 3 remain unfilled ([2,4],[3,3],[5,5],[6,4],[1,3],[5,3],[7,4],[1,4],[2,5],[5,6]). High rattle (0.7) failed to escape duplicate traps. Strategy: shift to strain-heavy (0.5) to systematically push descriptor values into empty regions; reduce rattle (0.2) which produces local duplicates; keep permute (0.3) for cation-ordering diversity. Target 12 cells: 4 persistent adjacent gaps ([1,3],[4,3],[5,3],[6,4]), 4 new outward from cluster edges ([1,4],[2,2],[3,2],[4,7]), 2 around outlier [6,5] ([5,4],[6,6]), 2 further from outlier [7,5] ([7,4],[8,5]) to expand coverage into sparse descriptor space.

Final round (59/60 budget, 1 eval left). Duplicate crisis: 35/59 (59%) duplicates, coverage stuck at 7% (7/100 cells). Recent: strain 0/5 accepted, rattle 0/4 accepted, permute 2/3 accepted. Permute is only operator escaping duplicate traps by changing cation ordering within same cell. Target 6 empty cells adjacent to occupied cluster: [3,5],[3,6] (north edge of core cluster), [5,3] (southwest gap), [7,6] (east of outlier [7,5]), [2,4] (persistent gap north of best-voltage [2,3]), [5,5] (south of [4,5]).
